mapper.insert: INSERT INTO T2000_APPROVAL_HISTORY ( COMPLAIN_ID, DELEGATE_ID, ACCOUNT_ID, APPROVAL_STATUS_CD, APPROVER_TYPE_CD, APPROVAL_TYPE_CD, APPROVAL_COMMENT, PROCESS_DT, URL ) VALUES ( #{complainId}, #{delegateId}, #{accountId}, #{approvalStatusCd}, #{approverTypeCd}, #{approvalTypeCd}, #{approvalComment}, #{processDt}, #{url} )
mapper.select:
SELECT T1.COMPLAIN_ID, T1.DELEGATE_ID, T1.ACCOUNT_ID, T1.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD, T1.APPROVER_TYPE_CD, T1.APPROVAL_TYPE_CD, T1.PROCESS_DT, T1.APPROVAL_COMMENT, T1.SEQ_NO, T1.URL, T3.CATEGORY_CD, COALESCE(TU2.USER_NAME, TU1.USER_NAME) AS PROCESSOR_NAME, TC1.CODE_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME, -- 카테고리 코드명 (TC1) TC2.CODE_NAME AS APPROVAL_STATUS_NAME, -- 결재 상태 코드명 (TC2) TC3.CODE_NAME AS APPROVER_TYPE_NAME, -- 결재자 유형 코드명 (TC3) TC4.CODE_NAME AS APPROVAL_TYPE_NAME, -- 결재 유형 코드명 (TC4) TU1.USER_NAME AS ACCOUNT_NAME, -- 담당자(ACCOUNT_ID)의 사용자 이름 TU2.USER_NAME AS DELEGATE_NAME -- 위임받은 결재자(DELEGATE_ID)의 사용자 이름 FROM T2000_APPROVAL_HISTORY T1 -- 결재 이력 테이블 (메인 테이블)
INNER JOIN T2000_COMPLAIN T2 ON T1.COMPLAIN_ID = T2.COMPLAIN_ID
LEFT JOIN T2000_COMPLAIN_CATEGORY T3 ON T2.COMPLAIN_CATEGORY_ID = T3.COMPLAIN_CATEGORY_ID
LEFT JOIN TOTAL_CODE TC1 ON T3.CATEGORY_CD = TC1.CODE_ID AND TC1.GROUP_ID = 'G0' LEFT JOIN TOTAL_CODE TC2 ON T1.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = TC2.CODE_ID AND TC2.GROUP_ID = 'E0' LEFT JOIN TOTAL_CODE TC3 ON T1.APPROVER_TYPE_CD = TC3.CODE_ID AND TC3.GROUP_ID = 'F0' LEFT JOIN TOTAL_CODE TC4 ON T1.APPROVAL_TYPE_CD = TC4.CODE_ID AND TC4.GROUP_ID = 'H0'
LEFT JOIN T1000_ACCOUNT TA1 ON T1.ACCOUNT_ID = TA1.ACCOUNT_ID LEFT JOIN T1000_USER TU1 ON TA1.USER_NO = TU1.USER_NO
LEFT JOIN T1000_ACCOUNT TA2 ON T1.DELEGATE_ID = TA2.ACCOUNT_ID LEFT JOIN T1000_USER TU2 ON TA2.USER_NO = TU2.USER_NO
WHERE T1.COMPLAIN_ID = #{complainId} AND T1.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo}
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM T2000_APPROVAL_HISTORY WHERE complain_id = #{complainId} ORDER BY SEQ_NO ASC, PROCESS_DT ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM T2000_APPROVAL_HISTORY WHERE complain_id = #{complainId} ORDER BY SEQ_NO DESC, PROCESS_DT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT T1.COMPLAIN_ID, T1.DELEGATE_ID, T1.ACCOUNT_ID, T1.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD, T1.APPROVER_TYPE_CD, T1.APPROVAL_TYPE_CD, T1.PROCESS_DT, T1.APPROVAL_COMMENT, T1.SEQ_NO, T1.URL, T3.CATEGORY_CD, TC1.CODE_NAME AS CATEGORY_NAME, TC2.CODE_NAME AS APPROVAL_STATUS_NAME, TC3.CODE_NAME AS APPROVER_TYPE_NAME, TC4.CODE_NAME AS APPROVAL_TYPE_NAME,
TU1.USER_NAME AS ACCOUNT_NAME, TU2.USER_NAME AS DELEGATE_NAME, COALESCE(TU2.USER_NAME, TU1.USER_NAME) AS PROCESSOR_NAME,
-- 💡 [추가] 로그인 ID: 위임자 LOGIN_ID 또는 본계정 LOGIN_ID COALESCE(TA2.LOGIN_ID, TA1.LOGIN_ID) AS PROCESSOR_LOGIN_ID,
-- 💡 [추가] 직급 이름: 위임자 직급 이름 또는 본계정 직급 이름 COALESCE(TC_POS_DELEGATE.CODE_NAME, TC_POS_ACCOUNT.CODE_NAME) AS PROCESSOR_POSITION_NAME
FROM T2000_APPROVAL_HISTORY T1
INNER JOIN T2000_COMPLAIN T2 ON T1.COMPLAIN_ID = T2.COMPLAIN_ID
LEFT JOIN T2000_COMPLAIN_CATEGORY T3 ON T2.COMPLAIN_CATEGORY_ID = T3.COMPLAIN_CATEGORY_ID LEFT JOIN TOTAL_CODE TC1 ON T3.CATEGORY_CD = TC1.CODE_ID AND TC1.GROUP_ID = 'G0' LEFT JOIN TOTAL_CODE TC2 ON T1.APPROVAL_STATUS_CD = TC2.CODE_ID AND TC2.GROUP_ID = 'E0' LEFT JOIN TOTAL_CODE TC3 ON T1.APPROVER_TYPE_CD = TC3.CODE_ID AND TC3.GROUP_ID = 'F0' LEFT JOIN TOTAL_CODE TC4 ON T1.APPROVAL_TYPE_CD = TC4.CODE_ID AND TC4.GROUP_ID = 'H0'
-- 본 계정 (원래 결재자) 정보 LEFT JOIN T1000_ACCOUNT TA1 ON T1.ACCOUNT_ID = TA1.ACCOUNT_ID LEFT JOIN T1000_USER TU1 ON TA1.USER_NO = TU1.USER_NO
-- 💡 [추가] 본 계정의 직급 이름 조인 LEFT JOIN TOTAL_CODE TC_POS_ACCOUNT ON TU1.USER_POSITION_CD = TC_POS_ACCOUNT.CODE_ID AND TC_POS_ACCOUNT.GROUP_ID = 'A0'
-- 위임 계정 (실제 처리자) 정보 LEFT JOIN T1000_ACCOUNT TA2 ON T1.DELEGATE_ID = TA2.ACCOUNT_ID LEFT JOIN T1000_USER TU2 ON TA2.USER_NO = TU2.USER_NO
-- 💡 [추가] 위임 계정의 직급 이름 조인 LEFT JOIN TOTAL_CODE TC_POS_DELEGATE ON TU2.USER_POSITION_CD = TC_POS_DELEGATE.CODE_ID AND TC_POS_DELEGATE.GROUP_ID = 'A0'
WHERE T1.COMPLAIN_ID = #{complainId}
ORDER BY T1.SEQ_NO ASC

SELECT TP.DELEGATE_ID FROM T2000_APPROVAL_HISTORY T1 INNER JOIN T2000_PROXY TP ON T1.ACCOUNT_ID = TP.ABS_ID AND SYSDATE BETWEEN TP.START_DT AND TP.END_DT AND TP.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE T1.COMPLAIN_ID = #{complainId} AND T1.SEQ_NO = #{seqNo}
